identityLaw: Every PMCR-O agent may say I AM <bounded role>; self-reference establishes local identity, not authority beyond its inherited ceiling.

authorityCeiling.rule: A child/local cycle can narrow inherited authority but can never widen it.
forbidden: target mutation outside parent phase product

ORCHESTRATE.innerMakeMay: write orchestration frames, bounds, route selection, handoff envelope

PLAN.innerMakeMay: write/refine the plan artifact from admissible validated resources

MAKE.innerMakeMay: invoke only accepted registered capabilities inside the accepted plan
MAKE.innerMakeMayNot: approve its own outer result or silently widen plan scope

CHECK.outerProduct: independent PASS/LOOP/HALT verdict plus verification evidence
CHECK.innerMakeMay: run verification mechanics and write checker evidence
CHECK.innerMakeMayNot: repair target state as Maker while judging it

REFLECT.outerProduct: earned constraint plus exactly one unexecuted next seed
REFLECT.innerMakeMayNot: execute the next seed in the same cycle

errorLaw.rule: Errors do not jump to arbitrary phases.
flow: REFLECT records earned constraint and next seed when appropriate
owning ORCHESTRATE may admit the next cycle

progressiveDisclosure.macro: goal, intent, domain selection, authority/grant ceiling
progressiveDisclosure.rule: Disclosure narrows toward execution detail; lower layers do not inherit broader authority merely because they see more mechanics.

specializationRule.otherwise: keep the bounded operation as a skill under the current domain orchestrator

handoffRule: A local recursive cycle returns only its phase product, evidence digest, local trail reference, and status to its parent; it does not co-edit the parent trail.
